Well this is the first time I have tried this so here goes.  I have been waiting as have the rest of us...except those with friends for the release of A Memory of Light for over a year now.  I spent the winter and spring of 2010-11 finally reading the first 13 books of the Epic which I'd resisted for years. Actually I am glad I waited to read them all at once as it were.  Now having just purchased the book and read the first 53 pages I can say it appears Sanderson did a masterful job of staying true to Jordan's original Vision and continuing the climactic pace established in The Gathering Storm and Towers of MidNight.  I am much interested in others' opinion of the work and of course I hope someone intends movies on the order of the Tolkien work.  Anyway just wanted to make some initial comments about this long awaited finale and to thank B. Sanderson and R. Jordan for giving us this treasure[[User:James Page|James Page]] ([[User talk:James Page|talk]]) 21:13, January 12, 2013 (UTC)James Page
